newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume and prices rise.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume and prices rise.

text.p: Prices firmed on Istanbul's gold exchange on Friday in lira and dollar terms, while volume increased, traders said on Friday.
Gold edged up to $382.35 from Thursday's $382.30 an ounce.
It jumped to 1,152,800 lira per gram from 1,148,150 at Thursday's close due to a weaker lira, which closed at 93,400 to the dollar versus 93,325 despite an easing dollar/mark parity.
Traded volume was 605 kilos after Thursday's 320 and almost 96 percent of it was in lira terms as players sought to take advantage of the lira's weakness.
But traders said volume remained thin, especially in the afternoon, because settlements are due on Tuesday due to the U.S. holiday on Monday.
Volume dropped to 229 kilos in the second session from 376 in the morning.
